import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
from common import validate
from planning import build_network, solve_builtin, solve_simplex
from bench2 import build
for nreq,noff,per in ((256,512,32),(1024,2048,32)):
    job=build(nreq,noff,per)
    context=validate(job)
    active={r['id']:True for r in context['requests'].values()}
    requests=context['requests']; offers=context['offers']
    pairs=[]
    for name in sorted(offers):
        offer=offers[name]
        for rid in offer['requests']:
            if not active.get(rid): continue
            request=requests[rid]
            if offer['service']!=request['service']: continue
            if request['at']>offer['time']: continue
            if offer['time']>=context['leases'][request['lease']]['end']: continue
            net=offer['network']
            if not int(net.network_address)<=request['address']<=int(net.broadcast_address): continue
            pairs.append((name,rid))
    nodes,edges,slots,source,sink,count=build_network(context,pairs)
    t=time.time(); v1,c1,ch1=solve_builtin(nodes,edges,source,sink); t1=time.time()-t
    t=time.time(); v2,c2,ch2=solve_simplex(nodes,edges,source,sink); t2=time.time()-t
    s1=set(ch1); s2=set(ch2)
    cost1=sum(offers[pairs[i][0]]['cost'] for i,pos in enumerate(slots) if pos in s1)
    cost2=sum(offers[pairs[i][0]]['cost'] for i,pos in enumerate(slots) if pos in s2)
    print('nreq=%d flow builtin=%d simplex=%d cost builtin=%d simplex=%d  (%.2fs vs %.2fs)'%(nreq,v1,v2,cost1,cost2,t1,t2))
